title: Vyral Public Contract Models
description: Canonical JSON Schema 2020-12 models shared by OpenAPI, SDKs, and MCP.

AdmissionReceipt.description: Durable, deterministic proof that one exact request was admitted or synchronously rejected. The referenced resource is authoritative for lifecycle state.

data.description: Consumer-owned JSON domain payload. Required for an upsert and null for a tombstone.

FilterNode.description: Recursive filter tree. Leaf nodes use path/op/value. Compound nodes use combine plus children.

value.description: Scalar JSON value for eq/neq/gt/gte/lt/lte/contains/startsWith. The in operator requires an array of scalar JSON values. The exists operator accepts a boolean; omitted/null means true. Object values and non-in arrays are rejected.

prefixMatching.description: When true, lexical terms with at least prefixMinChars characters can match indexed tokens by prefix.

requiredPhraseGroups.description: A conjunction of phrase disjunctions: every inner group must match at least one contiguous phrase within one scalar value of a selected lexical field (for example, one JSON array element).

provider.description: Optional provider id for ai.rerank. The server defaults to Retrieval:Rerank:Provider or local-token-overlap-reranker.

candidateLimit.description: Number of initially retrieved candidates to pass to the reranker before the final retrieval limit is applied.

contentField.description: Simple content field to send as candidate text. RAG context requests default this to contentField when omitted.

fallbackOnFailure.description: When true, retrieval falls back to the pre-rerank ranking if the rerank provider fails or rejects the request, with fallback diagnostics on the returned matches and trace summary.

token.description: Compact JWT validated only against the configured generic external-context policy.

id.description: Alias for providerId for generic descriptor consumers.

maxRecords.description: Maximum records included in this snapshot. Defaults to 10000 when omitted.

contentHash.description: Stable sha256 hash over collection, policy, and ordered records. exportedAt, recordCount, and contentHash are not included in the hash material.

maxRecords.description: Maximum records to include in the export snapshot. Defaults to 10000 when omitted.

preconditions.description: Optional write preconditions aligned by index with records. Omit or provide one item per record.

ifMatch.description: Expected current record ETag. Equivalent to the HTTP If-Match header for single-record writes.

ifNoneMatch.description: Use '*' for create-only semantics, or an ETag that must not match the current record.

expectedEtag.description: Expected current record ETag for compare-and-set writes.

expectedRevision.description: Expected current record revision for compare-and-set writes.

field.description: Vector field to query or populate, such as contentEmbedding. Retrieval ignores this when vectorFields is supplied.

purpose.description: Embedding input purpose. Retrieval defaults to query; RAG ingestion defaults to passage.

queryPrefix.description: Optional request override prepended to query-purpose embedding input.

passagePrefix.description: Optional request override prepended to passage/document-purpose embedding input.

symmetricPrefix.description: Optional request override prepended to symmetric-purpose embedding input.

profile.description: Optional retrieval profile id. Built-in profiles are discoverable at /retrieval/profiles and apply local R&D defaults for omitted request fields.

embedding.description: Single-field embedding options for vector or hybrid retrieval. Ignored when vectorFields is non-empty.

vectorFields.description: Optional late-fusion vector field queries. When present, these replace the single embedding selector for vector/hybrid retrieval.

searchMode.description: Search mode. When omitted, Vyral infers vector if embedding or vectorFields is supplied; otherwise it uses lexical.

id.description: Stable variant id used in comparison output and baseline deltas.

profile.description: Optional retrieval profile id to overlay onto each case request.

id.description: Expected record id. When omitted, aliases, sourceIds, or sources must identify the expected match.

aliases.description: Alternate returned record ids accepted for this expected match.

sourceIds.description: Source reference ids accepted for this expected match.

sources.description: Source references and optional spans that may identify the expected match.

id.description: Hard-negative record id. When omitted, aliases, sourceIds, or sources must identify the hard negative.

aliases.description: Alternate returned record ids that should be treated as this hard negative.

sourceIds.description: Source reference ids that should be treated as this hard negative.

sources.description: Source references and optional spans that may identify the hard negative.

cases.description: Populated only when includeCaseResults is true.

embedding.description: Embedding field and input-shaping options for generated chunk vectors. Defaults to field contentEmbedding and purpose passage when omitted.

dryRun.description: When true, ingestion returns the planned chunk, embedding, stale-delete, and manifest actions without generating embeddings, writing records, deleting stale chunks, writing manifests, or persisting traces.

reuseExistingChunkVectors.description: When true, ingestion may reuse vector values from identical chunk text that was already embedded with the same provider, model, dimensions, field, datatype, and distance function.

vectorReuseScope.description: Controls where reusable chunk vectors may be found. request only uses earlier chunks in the same ingestion request, partition also searches the same partition, and collection searches all partitions in the collection.

deduplicateExistingChunks.description: When true, ingestion may skip writing duplicate chunk records and reference an existing canonical chunk with matching text hash, provider, model, dimensions, content field, and vector policy.

chunkDedupeScope.description: Controls where duplicate chunk records may be found. request references earlier chunks in the same ingestion request, partition also searches the same partition, and collection searches all partitions in the collection.

persistManifest.description: When true, ingestion writes or reuses a rag.manifest record describing chunk ids, spans, hashes, embedding config, and source/metadata hashes without storing raw source text.

manifestId.description: Optional manifest record id. Defaults to the normalized idPrefix plus '-manifest'.

expectedPlanHash.description: Optional planHash from a prior dry-run or planned ingestion. The response reports whether the actual planHash matched.

expectedManifestHash.description: Optional manifestHash from a prior dry-run or manifest inspection. The response reports whether the actual manifestHash matched.

continueOnError.description: When false, batch ingestion stops after the first item failure. When true, later items are attempted and failures are returned per item.

planHash.description: Stable hash of the planned ingestion writes, vector policy, source/metadata hashes, counters, chunk actions, and manifest plan. It excludes dry-run state, etags, revisions, timestamps, trace ids, and raw source text.

dryRun.description: True when counts and actions describe a plan rather than committed writes.

deletedStaleCount.description: Number of stale document chunks deleted, or planned for deletion when dryRun is true.

vectorGeneratedCount.description: Number of chunk embeddings generated during this ingestion request, or planned for generation when dryRun is true. Unchanged skipped chunks are not counted.

vectorReusedCount.description: Number of written chunk records whose vector values were copied from an existing matching chunk vector.

deduplicatedCount.description: Number of chunk writes skipped because an existing canonical chunk was referenced instead.

staleDeletes.description: Stale chunk records deleted by replacement ingestion, or planned for deletion when dryRun is true.

charStart.description: Zero-based UTF-16 character offset in normalized source text.

charEnd.description: Exclusive zero-based UTF-16 character offset in normalized source text.

embeddingAction.description: Describes embedding work for this chunk. unchanged means the existing chunk record was current and was not rewritten.

query.description: Optional field-specific query text. Defaults to the parent retrieval query.

embedding.description: Optional field-specific embedding input-shaping options. The field property is ignored here; use the vector field query's field property.

retrieval.description: Retrieval request used to select candidate chunks before context assembly.

maxCitationsPerChunk.description: Optional cap on source citations emitted per returned chunk. Omitted citations are counted in omittedCitationCount.

includeCitations.description: When true, context assembly returns stable citation ids on chunks plus an envelope-level citation list with source metadata and included spans.

includeContextText.description: When true, context assembly includes a deterministic prompt-ready citation-markdown context block derived from the returned chunks and citations.

collection.description: Graph collection containing ROMAN/Vyral graph records.

seedNodeIds.description: Explicit graph node ids to use in addition to ids resolved from retrieved records.

seedJsonPointers.description: Record JSON pointers used to derive graph seed node ids from retrieval hits.

groupBy.description: How context assembly should resolve group keys. metadata accepts a metadata key or /metadata JSON pointer in groupByPath; jsonPointer accepts a full record JSON pointer.

groupByPath.description: Metadata key or JSON pointer used by metadata/jsonPointer grouping.

priority.description: Lower values are assembled earlier when contextAssembly authority ordering is active.

contextText.description: Prompt-ready context block when includeContextText is true.

charStart.description: Zero-based UTF-16 character offset in normalized source text.

charEnd.description: Exclusive zero-based UTF-16 character offset in normalized source text.

includedSourceSpan.description: Source span adjusted to the included context excerpt when the source span has charStart/charEnd.

limit.description: Maximum number of matching traces to prune. Defaults to 100 and cannot exceed 5000.

leaseToken.description: Opaque bearer secret. Do not log or put it in a URL.

purpose.description: Embedding input purpose. Defaults to symmetric for direct embedding requests.

queryPrefix.description: Optional request override prepended to query-purpose embedding input.

passagePrefix.description: Optional request override prepended to passage/document-purpose embedding input.

symmetricPrefix.description: Optional request override prepended to symmetric-purpose embedding input.

EmbeddingRequest.description: Request one or more vectors from the server's configured embedding provider. Supply either text, texts, or both.

advisory.description: True when the values should be used for scheduling/backoff guidance rather than hard authorization.

registrationStatus.description: Registration state for this provider capability, typically registered or disabled.

registrationHint.description: Operator-facing configuration hint when registrationStatus is not registered.

canRunUnvalidated.description: True when a provider capability is callable but not validated, allowing local-dev callers to opt in while strict consumers keep failing closed on ready=false.

modelId.description: Optional request-level model selection for providers that support dynamic model routing. Providers that do not support dynamic selection may ignore it or report unsupported behavior in their model catalog/readiness metadata.

payload.description: Provider capability payload. Standard Vyral AI payloads are listed in x-vyral-capabilityPayloads; provider-specific operations may accept extension payloads.

artifactDirectory.description: Optional for library-hosted provider runs. The local HTTP server ignores request-provided artifact paths and uses Providers:ArtifactDirectory when configured.

meteringContext.description: Optional opaque provider-thread and runner-session correlation for metering. Vyral assigns run identifiers at admission; these values grant no authority.

output.description: Provider capability output. Non-success results remain clearly marked by status/failureClass/error and should not be treated as capability output.

error.description: Human-readable provider error text when the run did not succeed.

rejection.description: Safe non-raw diagnostic for non-success provider runs. Parsed output on a rejected run is not capability output unless an operator explicitly adopts it outside the provider contract.

metering.description: Source-labelled metering receipts. Presence does not imply that a receipt is signed or independently reviewed.

category.description: Normalized providerStatus, failure class, or provider-policy category.

message.description: Safe human-readable diagnostic that does not echo raw provider output.

contentUsable.description: False for all non-success runs; provider output must not be treated as capability output.

parsedOutputPresent.description: True when Vyral could parse structured provider output even though the run did not succeed.

structuredOutputAccepted.description: True when parsed output matched a standard Vyral structured-output shape well enough to expose for diagnostics. This does not make it usable capability output.

structuredOutputValidationStatus.description: Validation status from the structured-output normalizer, such as provider_json or provider_jsonish.

decisionAuthority.description: Who made the terminal non-success decision: local Vyral validation/guardrail, provider process/response status, or server admission guardrail.

processOutcome.description: Safe non-raw execution outcome used to classify the run.

requestHash.description: Hash of the submitted provider payload. Raw provider input is not stored in the job envelope.

metering.description: Convenience projection of terminal result metering receipts.

meteringReceiptHashes.description: Full-envelope hashes of metering receipts associated with this trace.

AiMeteringContext.description: Optional caller correlation for a provider thread, runner session, or turn. Vyral-owned run identifiers are assigned at admission.

AiMeteringSubject.description: Correlated Vyral run, provider thread, runner session, and turn scopes. Their relationship is intentionally not assumed to be one-to-one.

observedStartedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision.

observedCompletedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision.

elapsedDurationMs.description: Observer wall duration, measured with a monotonic clock where available.

providerDurationMs.description: Provider-reported or provider-adapter duration; its source must not be confused with observer elapsed time.

method.description: Required by the contract validator when quality is estimated.

redacted.description: Whether sensitive content was omitted or represented only by a digest.

signature.description: Base64url-encoded 64-byte IEEE P1363 ES256 signature over the protected integrity statement that binds the evidence schema, algorithm, issuer, key ID, and canonical payload hash.

attestationLevel.description: Strongest evidence supporting the receipt. A signature authenticates an assertion but does not automatically promote this level.

sequence.description: Optional position in a producer-managed chain. Null denotes a standalone receipt.

previousReceiptHash.description: Full-envelope hash of the immediately preceding receipt in this chain.

issuedAt.description: UTC RFC 3339 timestamp with millisecond precision.

integrity.description: Optional cryptographic integrity assertion. Trust remains dependent on the caller's issuer/key policy.

wallSpanDurationMs.description: Span from the earliest start to latest completion; includes gaps.

summedElapsedDurationMs.description: Sum of per-run monotonic elapsed durations; can include concurrent work.

receiptKind.description: Evidence stream retained during aggregation so independent observations are never added silently to runner summaries.

evidenceIssuer.description: Protected issuer identity of the receipt whose measurements contributed to this total.

AiMeteringReview.description: A separately reviewable assessment over the exact ordered receipt set identified by receiptHashes. The basic-v1 ruleset does not by itself claim that this set exhausts every run in the named scope.

receiptHashes.description: Ordered full-envelope hashes of the receipts assessed by this review.

aggregate.description: Verified totals. Null when review errors make aggregation unsafe.

contentBlocks.description: Structured content blocks for multi-modal or tool-result messages. Providers that do not support blocks fall back to content.

admission.description: Rejected durable-admission proof when the failure occurred at the execution admission boundary.
